evidence_set: Stated limitations: the cause of death determined by the assigned forensic pathologist was assumed correct; illicit drugs present at death were taken as at least contributing except in deaths with class I natural or traumatic processes; the sample reflects western North Carolina only. In the Conclusions the authors call the almost 10% false-positive rate a significant number of cases that could have been misclassified, while describing the study as informational and its data as not meant to sway offices toward one practice.
